title: Quick commerce logs 44 million orders, ₹2,500 crore GMV over Diwali
description:
Quick commerce platforms in India clocked about Rs 2,500 crore in gross merchandise value (GMV) and 44 million orders across Dhanteras, Chhoti Diwali and Diwali from November 6-8, about 1.8 times the Diwali 2025 level, according to data from Redseer.
An average day across quick commerce platforms in September 2026 generated about Rs 550 crore in GMV, more than any single festive day of Diwali 2025, when even Dhanteras stayed under Rs 500 crore, the data showed.
Dhanteras, the day many households traditionally buy gold, silver and utensils, remained the biggest day for quick commerce, with GMV of Rs 850-900 crore against Rs 490 crore in 2025, according to Redseer.
Platforms handled about 15 million orders, or around 175 orders every second, which works out to about 1,600 orders per store across roughly 9,500 dark stores.
Dhanteras grew about 1.8 times and Chhoti Diwali about 1.7 times, while Diwali day jumped about 1.9 times, the fastest among the three days.
